info.title: Shortext API
info.description:
**Versioning**: every version is a frozen contract. A released version only receives additive changes
(new endpoints, new optional fields, new response fields); anything breaking ships in a new version.
Responses carry `X-Shortext-Api-Version`. When a version is scheduled for removal, responses also carry
`Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers; after the sunset date the version answers HTTP 410.
The list of versions and their status is available at `GET /api/versions`.

**Responses**: always HTTP 200. Check `success` and `code` (`1000` = success), see `ApiEnvelope`.
On failure, `trace_id` identifies the request for support.

**Rate limit**: 300 requests per minute per company, shared by all its keys and by every API version.
Responses carry `X-RateLimit-Limit` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining`; beyond the limit the API answers
HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` (seconds) and the usual envelope. Prefer webhooks to polling.

Member.description: User of the company (dashboard, mobile app)

id.description: Public representation of dynamic links, the apps they open and their clicks (API v2.0)

deep_link.description: Opened in the app when it is installed

fallback_url.description: Opened on a computer, or when no app matches

name.description: Required on creation, unique in the company

short_code.description: Path of the short URL; generated when absent

android_platform_id.description: An Android app (GET /deep-links/platforms); at least one platform

ios_platform_id.description: An iOS app; at least one platform

app_identifier.description: Android package name or iOS bundle id

FollowUp.description: A follow-up on a conversation: messages sent to the contact until they reply, or until the maximum of the type is reached.

id.description: Public representation of follow-ups and their types (API v2.0)

status.description: `scheduled`: follow-ups still to send. `resolved`: the customer replied or someone closed it as done. `exhausted`: every follow-up was sent without a reply. `cancelled`. `failed`: the channel refused the sends.

reason.description: What is expected from the contact; the AI writes the follow-ups from it

message.description: Fixed text sent instead of the AI-written one

failed.description: Sends the channel refused (not counted in `sent`)

reason.description: What is expected from the contact; the AI writes each follow-up from it

message.description: Fixed text to send instead of the AI-written one

scheduled_at.description: First follow-up; by default after the delay of the type

campaign_id.description: The campaign the follow-up belongs to

description.description: Tells the AI when to set this type

overrides.description: Settings for one sender, over the type's own

channel_id.description: The sender: WhatsApp phone number id or mailbox id (GET /channels)

FollowUpTypeInput.description: On update, only the fields given change; `overrides`, when given, replaces them all.

id.description: Public representation of the knowledge of an agent (API v2.0): its documents and what it knows about contacts

content.description: Markdown; only when one document is read (`GET /agents/{agent}/knowledge/{id}`)

characters.description: Counted in the limit of the plan

source.description: `pdf` when the text comes from an uploaded PDF

KnowledgeDocumentInput.description: JSON, or multipart/form-data to upload a PDF

title.description: Required unless a PDF gives one

content.description: Markdown; required unless a PDF is sent

file.description: PDF (10 MB max): its text becomes the content when none is sent

used.description: Characters of all the documents of the agent

content.example: Prefers to be called Mrs. Ndongo; VIP customer since 2023.

id.description: Public representation of a message (API v2.0): exactly the data of the message.* webhooks.
Id on the channel (your own id for Shortext)

MessageInput.description: Grammar of a message, the same on every endpoint and version

content.description: `text`: `{ text }`. `template`: `{ template_name, language, body?, header?, buttons?, code? }` (body/header: `{ variable: value }`; buttons: `{ index: value }` for the buttons that need one, see GET /templates; code: the code of an authentication template). `interactive`: `{ type, body, action, header?, footer? }`. `media`: `{ media_type, media_url, caption?, filename?, mime? }` (media_type: image, video, document, audio)

handover.description: The reply takes the conversation over: the AI agent stops answering. Send false for a notification that lets the agent continue.

id.description:
Public representation of a WhatsApp template (API v2.0). A template belongs to a WhatsApp Business
Account: every number of that account can send it (`channels`).

status.description: Only APPROVED templates can be sent

channels.description: WhatsApp channel ids (channel_id) of the company that can send it

media_url.description: Media header: sent when message.content.header.url is not given

buttons.description: In order: `message.content.buttons` = `{ index: value }` for the buttons that need a value

needs_value.description: A dynamic link (its end), a copy code button (the coupon) or the code of an authentication template (or send `message.content.code`)

id.description: Public representation of tickets, their statuses, priorities and activity (API v2.0)

conversation_id.description: Conversation of the contact the ticket is about

contact.description: Same block as in a Conversation

conversation_id.description: Required on creation: the ticket follows the contact of this conversation and the agent of its channel

status.description: Status code of the agent; on creation, its first open status by default. A resolved or terminal status resolves or closes the ticket, an open one reopens it.

priority.description: SLA policy code of the agent: sets the due dates; null removes it

code.description: Slug of the name: what tickets refer to

name.description: Required on creation; renaming changes the code

priority.description: Slug of the label: what tickets refer to

response_time.description: Working minutes to answer (Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 18:00)

label.description: Required on creation; renaming changes the priority code

body.description: Endpoint payload, null when there is none

trace_id.description: Present only when success is false

ApiPage.description: A page of results: `data` holds the items. Ask another page with `?page=`

HostedSession.description: A signed, expiring, single-use link to one of our hosted pages, and its outcome

url.description: Only in the creation response: the page to give to your user. It holds a secret, never log or share it.

return_url.description: Your page the user is sent back to, with ?session_id=...&status=...

filters.description: Only receive events whose context matches, e.g. one agent

api_version.description: Version of the payloads sent to this endpoint

disabled_reason.description: Set when disabled after failing for 3 days

WebhookEventPayload.description:
Body POSTed to your endpoint. Answer with a 2xx within 10 s and process asynchronously.
Failed deliveries are retried after 10 s, 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 12 h;
an endpoint failing for 3 days is disabled.
Delivery order is not guaranteed and an event may be delivered twice: dedupe on `id`.

**Signature**: `X-…-Signature: sha256=hex(hmac_sha256(secret, "{X-…-Timestamp}.{raw body}"))`.
Compare in constant time and reject timestamps older than 5 minutes.

bearerAuth.description: Company API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Create it in the dashboard (Developer > API Keys) with the permissions the integration needs.
